evidenceGaps: No dual-color Breathing interval was performed. The capture contains single green, random color, and single white Breathing only.

Five random peaks establish per-cycle color changes but are insufficient to infer Synapse's exact random palette or probability distribution. The observed sequence uses RGB components from 00, 80, and FF; a longer capture is required before claiming exact random-color generation.
No physical-key Reactive pulse reached this capture after the Reactive matrix became black, so Short fade duration cannot be derived.
Reactive Long was not configured and no Long physical-key pulse was captured.
The capture timed out before a visually confirmed restoration to Ambient Awareness. The OpenBlade service was restarted successfully, but visual effect restoration is not claimed.
notes: The raw PCAP remains outside the repository; only hashes, timestamps, decoded commands, and bounded observations are committed.
The five random Breathing peak colors are successive full-matrix colors approximately seven seconds apart, establishing that random mode chooses a new color per cycle.
Falling frames keep the old random color, the black hold hides the color change, and rising frames use the next random color.
Single and random intervals independently reproduce the same four-quarter trapezoid seen in the core capture.
The 100 matrix reports from the first all-black Reactive frame through the end of capture are all black. Periodic black keepalive frames are not physical-key evidence.
The Starlight interval was an accidental UI selection and is explicitly excluded from production admission.
